exposure: standardized clinical assessment and management plan (SCAMP)
cohort: 496 pregnant women with prenatally diagnosed fetal congenital heart disease
finding: Implementation of a standardized clinical assessment and management plan (SCAMP) decreased the rate of early-term deliveries and cesarean deliveries for pregnant women with prenatal congenital heart disease.
mod_finding: Vaginal delivery was recommended in 77% of the intervention cohort, resulting in 61% vaginal deliveries versus 50% in the control cohort.
